items.title: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹 / Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says

sources.title: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹 / Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.title_zh: FBI 称前 OpenAI 工程师涉嫌窃密，手机中发现 Saudi Gov Docs 文件夹
sources.title_en: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.title_original: Accused OpenAI spy had folder called “Saudi Gov Docs,” FBI says
sources.summary: 美国法院批准羁押被指控在 OpenAI 会议室安装窃听器的前工程师 Abdulrahman Alfozan。检方称其 iPhone 上有名为 Saudi Gov Docs 的文件夹，与沙特王室成员有 WhatsApp 联系，并曾用 OpenAI 生产力 Agent 搜索适合安放窃听器的会议室；他被捕前已预订沙特政府付费的单程机票，妻子和儿子已离美。

sources.title_original: Apate.ai 用35万个AI反诈拖住骗子，国内年轻人用AI视频反制AI卖惨账号
sources.summary: 作者讲述了两起用AI反制诈骗的案例。澳大利亚公司 Apate.ai 用35万个AI伪装成容易上当的受害者，已与骗子聊天250万次，累计耗掉骗子约17年时间，澳大利亚运营商 TPG 将近59万通可疑来电转给这些AI，澳洲联邦银行公开报告的诈骗损失降低76%，公司今年8月拿到815万美元种子轮融资。

items.title: DeepSeek 以 Apache-2.0 开源大规模推理框架 DeepInfer / DeepSeek just open sourced its high-performance, large-scale inference framework DeepInfer in Apache-2.0 license.

sources.title: DeepSeek 以 Apache-2.0 开源大规模推理框架 DeepInfer / DeepSeek just open sourced its high-performance, large-scale inference framework DeepInfer in Apache-2.0 license.
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek 以 Apache-2.0 开源大规模推理框架 DeepInfer
sources.title_en: DeepSeek just open sourced its high-performance, large-scale inference framework DeepInfer in Apache-2.0 license.
sources.title_original: DeepSeek just open sourced its high-performance, large-scale inference framework DeepInfer in Apache-2.0 license.
sources.summary: DeepSeek 开源高性能大规模推理框架 DeepInfer，采用 Apache-2.0 许可，仓库地址 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer。支持优化 kernel、模型与 sampler 运行时，Attention DP、平衡 CP、MoE EP + EPLB 等并行方案，以及 DSpark、置信度调度验证、SWA bounded replay、零开销异步批量调度、batch-invariant 推理、确定性采样和结构化输出。
